title: Clean Alert Acknowledgement Timestamps
prompt: Your observability platform stores alert acknowledgement data with messy timestamp formatting. The `ack_timestamp_raw` column contains ISO-8601 timestamps as TEXT with inconsistent whitespace and capitalization in the timezone suffix. You need to parse these timestamps and extract useful time components for dashboards. Write a query that cleans the timestamp data and extracts: (1) the cleaned timestamp as a proper TIMESTAMP type in column `ack_timestamp`, (2) the hour of day (0-23) as an INTEGER in column `ack_hour`, (3) the start of the acknowledgement month (truncated to midnight on the 1st) as a TIMESTAMP in column `ack_month_start`, and (4) a human-readable format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' as TEXT in column `ack_formatted`. Some rows have leading/trailing whitespace in the raw timestamp that must be removed. Order results by `alert_id`.
schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE alert_acknowledgements (
  alert_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  alert_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL,
  ack_timestamp_raw TEXT,
  ack_user TEXT NOT NULL
);

hints: You'll need to clean the raw text before converting it to a timestamp type.

Use TRIM or BTRIM to remove whitespace, then cast the result to TIMESTAMP. For extracting components, use EXTRACT(hour FROM ...) to get an integer hour, DATE_TRUNC('month', ...) to get the start of the month, and TO_CHAR(..., 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') for formatting.

The complete solution: SELECT alert_id, (TRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP as ack_timestamp, EXTRACT(hour FROM (TRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP)::INTEGER as ack_hour, DATE_TRUNC('month', (TRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP) as ack_month_start, TO_CHAR((TRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as ack_formatted. NULL inputs will propagate through all transformations.
answer_key:
SELECT
  alert_id,
  (BTRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP AS ack_timestamp,
  EXTRACT(hour FROM (BTRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP)::INTEGER AS ack_hour,
  DATE_TRUNC('month', (BTRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP) AS ack_month_start,
  TO_CHAR((BTRIM(ack_timestamp_raw))::TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ack_formatted
FROM alert_acknowledgements
ORDER BY alert_id;

_meta.scenario: an observability platform tracking alert acknowledge time and MTTR
